title: Principal Solutions Architect, Professional Services
description:

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

THE ROLE

Docker is launching a Professional Services organization to accelerate customer success, reduce time-to-value, and drive enterprise adoption for agentic workloads. As a Principal Solution Architect, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling this function. You will join a team of seasoned experts with deep experience backed by Docker's unmatched reach across Fortune 500 companies.

 

This is a high-visibility role working directly with senior leadership across revenue, product, marketing, and partner organizations. You'll shape service strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver offerings that accelerate both services revenue and platform expansion.

 

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to our largest and most strategic partners and enterprise customers, providing thought leadership on integrating Docker agentic solutions within enterprise environments.

- Identify offerings that drive product expansion, renewals, and long-term customer value.

- Support Partnerships & Alliances in selecting, onboarding, and enabling technical integration partners, system integrators (SIs), and service delivery partners.

- Lead technical discovery and architecture engagements that span enterprise integration layers

- Position Docker as a strategic and thought leadership partner, influencing long-term technology adoption and investment decisions.

- Directly deliver or assign and oversee appropriate delivery partners to execute service engagements and ensure technical objectives are met.

title: Campaign Coordinator - Lead Generation
description:

• Maintain accurate record-keeping of campaigns in Trello and custom trackers.

• Support with additional administrative tasks as required.

Qualifications:

• 1+ years of experience working with email marketing.

• Experience with marketing automation and CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, MailChimp)

• Excellent communication skills to report results to stakeholders and work cross-functionally with multiple departments and multiple brands.

• Industry Expertise: Familiarity with the digital publishing, lead generation campaigns, or science sectors is highly desirable.

Necessary Skills and Experience:

• Highly organized

• Excellent attention to detail

• Data Driven

• Ability to handle multiple tasks at any one time

• Customer focused

• Effective communication skills

• Enthusiasm and self-motivation

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

title: End of Year Campaign Manager
description:
Location: Remote within the United States (Eligible applicants must be physically based within the US.)
Time Commitment: This is a project-based position with defined deliverables; time commitment per week during the project duration may vary.
Organization Overview
The Elba Hope Foundation is a nonprofit organization. At our heart lies a steadfast commitment to sustainable progress and better futures for Africans and the African Diaspora through the interconnected tools of agriculture, conservation, food security, education, youth advocacy, and social justice. Our mission is to drive transformative change by fostering innovation, empowering communities, and forming strategic partnerships that will have a lasting impact on these sectors, both today and for future generations.
Position Overview
Your role will focus on:

• Owning the day-to-day delivery of EHF's 2026 End of Year Campaign and turning the existing strategy into a clear, executable Asana workplan.

• Coordinating EHF team members, creative partners, and vendors so work moves forward on schedule, outstanding inputs are chased, and blockers are resolved quickly.

• Managing production of campaign content and collateral across digital, donor-facing, and physical channels.

• Building repeatable campaign systems, assets, and learnings that EHF can carry into 2027.

Key Responsibilities
Campaign Management

• Translate the existing EOY campaign plan and Executive Director direction into a master roadmap in Asana with owners, deadlines, dependencies, and approval points.

• Maintain the Asana tracker as the source of truth and actively follow up on outstanding inputs, deadlines, approvals, and deliverables.

• Run a weekly campaign coordination meeting and surface blockers, risks, and decisions before they affect the campaign timeline.

• Manage the campaign schedule through January follow-up activity and keep the work focused on one coherent institutional story across visibility, stewardship, and fundraising moments.

Content, Creative & Vendor Production

• Manage production across email, social, web, campaign landing pages, the year-end newsletter, Impact Report, EOY recap content, donor materials, and gifting.

• Prepare creative briefs and coordinate graphic designers, video editors, printers, fulfillment vendors, and other production partners.

• Collect and organize required campaign inputs, including impact data, program updates, photography, video, copy, and donor information.

• Draft or refine campaign copy as needed, consolidate feedback, manage revision rounds, and ensure final materials are proofed, approved, and delivered on time.

Donor & Fundraising Coordination

• Work with EHF's Development Assistant and Development team on individual-giving tests, Giving Tuesday, audience segmentation, donor messaging, acknowledgements, and follow-up.

• Work with Operations to confirm donation links, landing pages, campaign tracking, UTMs or equivalent attribution, and reporting are ready before launch.

• Support a light-touch introduction of Friends of Hope during the campaign without turning it into a full launch.

• Coordinate EOY gifting production, including recipient inputs, notes or inscriptions, approvals, inventory, shipping, and fulfillment milestones.

Reporting & Handoff

• Provide a concise weekly status update covering completed work, next milestones, outstanding approvals, blockers, risks, and decisions required.

• Track agreed campaign measures and document which messages, audiences, channels, and creative approaches performed most effectively.

• Submit a final campaign wrap report with results, lessons learned, reusable assets and systems, and recommendations for 2027.

• Complete a final debrief and hand back campaign files, trackers, templates, and vendor information in an organized format.

Major Deliverables

• Master campaign roadmap and live Asana tracker

• Integrated campaign messaging and content calendar

title: Mechanical Engineer, Robotics
description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
The Role
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will own the design, analysis, and validation of the structural and kinematic systems that make Asimov move. You will take components from concept through production-ready hardware -- working across joints, actuators, enclosures, and structural members -- ensuring every design holds up mechanically and integrates cleanly with the broader electromechanical system.
What You'll Do

• Design and develop mechanical assemblies across the full humanoid body, including joints, actuators, sensor mounts, and structural members

• Develop detailed 3D part, drawings and assembly models across plastics, metal, and composite materials in Solidworks or equivalent CAD tools

• Run hands-on test rigs: load testing, fatigue cycling, thermal soak, and kinematic validation across body segments

• Execute DFM reviews alongside contract manufacturers, going to the floor to understand tooling constraints, cycle times, and failure modes firsthand

• Create and maintain production drawings with GD&T and inspection callouts for handoff to CMs and QA

• Set up and instrument test stands, wire sensors, and collect data to analyze failure modes and close the loop on design iterations

• Work across plastics, metals, and composites, selecting materials and joining methods appropriate for the loading conditions and production intent

• Coordinate with firmware and electrical teams to physically integrate actuators, sensors, and PCBs into mechanical assemblies, ensuring cable routing, connector access, and serviceability are accounted for

• Contribute to Menlo 's open-source hardware releases, including build guides, BOM documentation, and assembly instructions for the communityContribute to Menlo 's open-source design efforts, including CAD releases, manufacturing documentation, and build guides for the broader robotics community

What You'll Bring

• 3 or more years of hands-on mechanical design experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

• Strong proficiency in Solidworks, across both detailed parts, multibody assemblies, surfaces and drawings

• Proven track record with sheet metal fabrication and traditional/additive manufacturing

• Experience with GD&T and producing 2D engineering drawings for manufacturing and QA

• Ability to run FEA simulations; static, dynamic & thermal as well as interpret results to inform design decisions

• Comfortable working within aggressive cost and weight constraints without sacrificing reliability

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with material selection, actuator selection, fasteners and mechanisms

• Proficient in rapid prototyping methods (FDM, SLA, CNC, laser cutting) and able to support the team on design decisions spanning the full product lifecycle, from concept through end-of-life disassembly and material recovery

• Strong communication skills to drive alignment across suppliers, cross-disciplinary engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

• Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware, legged locomotion platforms, or high DOF manipulators

• Participated in robotics competitions

• Familiarity with parallel mechanisms and non-standard joint configurations such as RSU ankle designs or parallel actuation

• Knowledge of plastics engineering including material selection, shrinkage factors, and mechanical property optimization

• Scripting or automation experience in Python to streamline CAD workflows and data analysis

Maintaining that momentum and continuing to deliver an exceptional player experience means that we’ve had to keep growing the team. ROLE OVERVIEW
Our award-winning team of game creators are looking to grow so that we can release even more transformative experiences to the millions of players that enjoy our games every day. Experienced industry veterans will understand that producing blockbuster titles is no easy feat, requiring an obsessive eye for every detail including the game design, mathematics, and artwork.
That’s where you would come in: we’re looking for a superstar game director who can work with our team to take game concepts, breathe life into them, and help turn them into hits.
If you’re able to expertly communicate your vision, guide game production from start to finish, inspire top design, production and development personnel, and work tireless to build games in service of entertaining our players, you’ll fit right in.

• Provide quality control over design outputs and production.

• Assist the teams with questions about the game direction and to help guide the specifications.

• Adjust designs based on feedback from stakeholders or from broader technical challenges, constraints, or limitations that may arise during the production process.

• Feedback on other proposed designs and requirements within the team, particularly in cases where it may affect the dependencies and connected interaction design.

• You will be playtesting your games like crazy: prepare to mark your own homework and ensure that all the details in your direction have been (a) implemented according to your vision and (b) play as well as you thought they would. You need to make sure that all the visuals, graphics, animations, micro-animations, flow, music, and SFX click together in a way that will resonate with the player.

• Define and evolve our game direction to weave consistence and game familiarity throughout our universe of titles (where you are involved) while still giving us enough flexibility to try new things.

• Discover how to incorporate elements of our branding into games or how our game direction style can become an intrinsic element of our corporate branding strategy.

MedWatch shares all clinical and demographic information on individual patients among our clerical and case management departments that have a need to know, to avoid duplicate request for information from enrollees or providers.

• Perform initial and concurrent reviews during hospital stays. Responsible for developing deployable analytical solutions in partnership with Engineering teams, while not owning production infrastructure or application development.

Model Development

• Design, develop and maintain statistical, probabilistic and simulation-based models.

• Translate complex business questions into tractable modelling problems.

• Select appropriate modelling approaches based on the characteristics of the problem rather than methodological preference.

• Develop prototypes and working solutions iteratively, refining approaches as new information becomes available.

• Build analytical assets that can be reused as products, decision-support tools or operational capabilities.

• Design and analyse experiments to evaluate interventions, operational changes and model effectiveness.

Inference & Uncertainty

• Work effectively with incomplete, imperfect and evolving datasets.

• Test assumptions and identify limitations within modelling approaches.

Optimisation & Decision Support

Validation & Quality

• Validate models using appropriate testing, back-testing and comparison techniques.

• Assess sensitivity to assumptions and changing conditions.

• Monitor model performance over time and identify concept drift or degradation.

• Maintain high standards of analytical rigour and reproducibility.

Collaboration & Communication

• Partner closely with Business Analysts, Engineering, Product and operational teams.

• Explain modelling approaches, assumptions and results clearly to non-technical audiences.

• Document methodologies, limitations and recommendations in a practical and accessible way.

• Contribute to a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making.

• Work closely with Engineering teams to translate models into scalable production solutions - Data Science defines the models while Engineering owns production implementation.

• Define model inputs, outputs, assumptions and performance requirements required for implementation.

• Support the development of APIs, services or analytical components by providing technical guidance and validation.

• Contribute to testing and acceptance of implemented solutions to ensure behaviour aligns with model expectations.

• Help define monitoring, evaluation and retraining requirements where appropriate.

• Partner with Product, Engineering and Business teams to ensure analytical solutions deliver measurable business value.

Essential

• Strong grounding in applied statistics, modelling, data science, operational research, economics, mathematics or a related quantitative discipline.

• Experience building models that support real-world decisions, products or operational processes.

• Experience working with uncertainty, incomplete information and imperfect datasets.

• Ability to move from loosely defined problems to practical analytical solutions.

• Strong problem decomposition and structured thinking skills.

title: Planning Executive
description:
About The Team:

The Planning team is the most data-driven team at HelloFresh: we plan, schedule and analyse the production of every box before it reaches our hungry customers across the UK. It's a team where technical skill genuinely moves the needle, and where the right person can make a real mark. This role is based in Derby, in our largest Distribution Centre in Europe.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Production & Capacity Planning: Build and maintain accurate production plans based on forecast demand, operational capacity, production constraints and site requirements.

• Rackplan Development: Create and validate rackplans that balance demand, SKU placement, capacity, stock availability and operational efficiency, understanding how planning decisions affect production flow.

• Plan vs Actual Analysis: Analyse planned versus actual performance, identify deviations and investigate the underlying drivers rather than simply reporting the variance.

• Operational Problem Solving: Use data to identify constraints, test assumptions and develop practical solutions to complex production and planning problems.

• Continuous Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve planning processes, including the practical application of AI and analytical tools.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Operations and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, challenge assumptions and ensure plans are executable on the production floor.

• Analytically strong: Comfortable working with large and complex datasets and able to turn data into clear operational decisions.

• Naturally curious: You don't stop at identifying that something went wrong; you want to understand why .

• Strong problem solver: Able to break complex operational problems into manageable components, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.

• Technically capable: Advanced spreadsheet skills, including building, interpreting and troubleshooting complex formulas. Experience with SQL, Python, BI tools or similar analytical technologies would be advantageous.

• Automation-minded: Able to identify repetitive or inefficient processes and use automation, AI or other technology to improve them. Previous development of AI-enabled tools or solutions is desirable.

• Operationally aware: Able to understand the relationship between a planning decision and what physically happens in a production or fulfilment environment.

• Confident communicator: Comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions and constructively pushing back when the data or operational reality doesn't support a decision.

• Detail-oriented: Planning errors can have significant operational consequences, so accuracy and disciplined validation are essential.

Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description:
Position Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Document Control Supervisor to lead document control activities supporting construction, engineering, quality, procurement, subcontractors, suppliers, and project management functions.
This role will oversee document control processes, systems, governance, and personnel for construction programs and projects. The supervisor will ensure that controlled documents and project records are received, processed, reviewed, approved, distributed, retrieved, retained, and protected in accordance with project procedures, the project Quality Management System, contractual requirements, client standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
The successful candidate will build order out of complexity, strengthen document control practices across field and office teams, and serve as a trusted partner to Project Managers, Construction Managers, Engineering, Quality, and Operations leaders. This position will also administer and improve systems such as Procore and SharePoint, provide training and user support, and drive continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Document Control and Records Management

• Lead project document control activities supporting construction, engineering, quality, procurement, project management, subcontractors, suppliers, and field operations.

• Develop, maintain, and administer document control processes and procedures for identifying, receiving, processing, reviewing, approving, revising, distributing, filing, preserving, retrieving, and retaining controlled documents and records.

• Administer controlled documents in accordance with the project Quality Management System, applicable ASME NQA-1 requirements, project procedures, client requirements, and contractual obligations.

• Control engineering and project documents, including drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, vendor documents, quality records, change requests, RFIs/RFPs, and construction documentation.

• Ensure personnel have access to the current, approved revisions of drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, and other controlled documents.

• Maintain document registers, revision histories, document status information, distribution records, transmittals, and other required tracking tools.

• Process new and revised documents through established review and approval workflows.

• Identify and prevent the unintended use of obsolete, superseded, or unapproved documents.

• Maintain document traceability and ensure controlled records are complete, legible, accurate, retrievable, secure, and protected from unauthorized access or alteration.

• Ensure the collection and retention of construction documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Manage the as-built documentation process and support the preparation, compilation, and turnover of final project records and closeout packages.

• Coordinate the handover of documents and records to Operations during construction and project closeout.

Systems Administration and Governance

• Administer, configure, and improve document management platforms, including Procore, SharePoint, and related electronic document management systems.

• Establish and maintain project repositories, file structures, naming conventions, metadata, permissions, workflows, document numbering, revision control, and distribution requirements.

• Provide oversight of employees, contractors, subcontractors, and other users operating within Procore and other project repositories.

• Perform quality control reviews

title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities

• Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how

title: User Experience Designer
description:
We are seeking a User Experience Designer to help design and improve digital experiences for Ford vehicle owners. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Analytics, and Design partners to understand customer needs and turn them into clear, accessible experiences.
You’ll contribute throughout the design process-from exploring customer problems and developing concepts to prototyping, validation, delivery, and post-launch improvement. This role is a chance to take ownership of well-scoped design work, collaborate across disciplines, and continue developing your craft.
You’ll also use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to support ideation, design exploration, and prototyping. You’ll be responsible for reviewing AI-assisted work for accuracy, accessibility, originality, brand fit, and customer usefulness, and for following guidance on approved tools and confidential information.
User Experience Design & Delivery

• Design and refine Ford .com experiences that help Owners find vehicle information, understand features, access services, and stay connected with Ford .

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs.

• Explore design options, communicate trade-offs, and incorporate feedback from customers and cross-functional partners.

• Create prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity to test assumptions, gather feedback, and support design decisions.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to balance customer value, business goals, accessibility, and technical feasibility.

• Use Ford ’s design system and contribute to consistent, reusable patterns across Ford .com.

• Support design delivery and collaborate with engineering partners to clarify design intent and implementation details.

Customer Research, Validation & Continuous Improvement

• Help identify customer needs and experience opportunities using research, customer feedback, analytics, and cross-functional input.

• Support usability testing and other evaluative activities, applying findings before and after launch.

• Use customer feedback and performance data to assess how experiences are working and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Iterate on designs as new information, feedback, or requirements emerge.

• Stay curious about evolving design practices and share useful learnings with the team.

Collaboration & Communication

• Communicate design rationale through presentations, prototypes, and clear documentation.

• Participate in design critiques, workshops, and planning with a collaborative, open-to-feedback mindset.

• Build productive working relationships with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Analytics, and Design partners.

• Explain design concepts and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

AI-Assisted Design

• Use approved AI-enabled tools to support design work, such as exploring concepts, organizing early ideas, developing prototype content, or streamlining repetitive tasks.

• Review AI-assisted outputs for accuracy, accessibility, originality, brand fit, and customer usefulness.

• Follow applicable guidance for approved tools and the handling of confidential information.

We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you’re excited about making Ford ownership more helpful and connected, and enjoy learning through collaboration and iteration, we encourage you to apply.
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in UX, interaction design, product design, human-computer interaction, visual design, or a related field-or equivalent practical experience.
Experience

• Approximately 2-4 years of experience in UX, product, interaction, or digital design, including relevant internships or project work.

• A portfolio demonstrating your design process and contributions to digital experiences, including how you framed problems, explored options, used feedback, and developed solution

Our mission is to expose the full capability of that hardware - limited only by physics - to the rest of the stack, all while retaining the smallest, most robust footprint possible.

• Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more)

• Demonstrated track record of developing and optimizing device/peripheral drivers - ideally for high-speed interfaces, or with advanced considerations like DMA and cache coherency

• Understanding of major peripheral hardware interface standards (Ethernet, PCIe, I2C, SPI, etc.) - you can critically review a schematic, and debug these interfaces if needed

• Experience with product security, OS/system hardening, and secure boot schemes

title: Product Engineer
description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack - a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade - this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT ENGINEER

Our hardest problems don’t stay in one layer. A customer issue can start in a web app and end in a Kubernetes scheduler, a container runtime or a GPU driver. We need engineers who can build the products, APIs and tools our customers use, and who understand the systems underneath well enough to make them work reliably in production.

This is a role for someone who takes a loosely defined problem, works out what the user actually needs, and owns the solution end to end. That means designing it, writing the code, shipping it, and debugging it when it breaks, without handing it off at the first layer boundary.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

• Own and drive user-facing products end to end, including web apps, APIs, backend services and CLI tools, mostly in Go. You’ll ship the simplest useful version first, then improve it based on how people actually use it.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering & DevOps, Infrastructure & Data Centre Operations

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Overview

Quarterhill is seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing team. This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the reliability and performance of smart transportation systems, including a next-generation, cloud-native tolling platform that processes roadway transactions and payments around the clock. As a Senior SRE, you will ensure our systems are highly available, resilient, and scalable, take a leading role in incident response and reliability engineering practices, and help optimize operations across infrastructure and applications.

Responsibilities

•
System Reliability: Monitor and maintain the health, availability, and performance of critical transportation services.

•
Reliability Standards: Define and track service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, and reliability metrics for revenue-critical services.

•
Incident Management: Lead incident response - perform root cause analysis, coordinate resolution across teams, and drive blameless post-incident reviews and follow-up actions.

•
Automation: Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline operational tasks and improve efficiency.

•
Monitoring & Performance: Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to track service health, performance, and resource utilization.

•
Capacity Planning: Help assess and plan for capacity, scaling infrastructure to meet growing transaction volumes - including stateful systems such as distributed SQL databases and event-streaming clusters (e.g., NATS, Kafka).

•
Collaboration: Work with software engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to improve the reliability of systems and services.

•
System Optimization: Identify performance bottlenecks, troubleshoot issues, and work on optimizations at both infrastructure and application layers.

•
Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the ongoing improvement of operational processes, documentation, and best practices in the SRE team.

•
Disaster Recovery: Participate in designing and testing disaster recovery plans to ensure the continuity of critical services.

This list of responsibilities might not cover everything you'll end up doing.

Qualifications

•
Experience: 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or a similar role, preferably in a mission-critical or large-scale environment, including experience leading incident response and mentoring other engineers.

•
Technical Skills:

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog, etc.).

• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

• Solid understanding of Linux and Windows administration.

•
Database Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) and distributed systems.

•
Collaboration & Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams to improve service reliability.

•

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

GLOBAL GOVERNMENT AFFAIRS DIRECTOR

We are seeking Global Government Affairs Director to support SpaceXSI’s business and growth objectives primarily in London/UK through direct global lobbying efforts and strategic coalition building on a range of issues.

This role combines strategic market leadership, high-level stakeholder engagement, revenue acceleration, and cross-functional influence. You will operate as an individual contributor while collaborating closely with global and local leadership to ensure government priorities align with and inform SpaceXSI’s broader international growth.

title: AI-Native Staff Product Designer, AI + Compute
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

As AI agents move into production, they need a foundation that keeps them running through failures, retries, and long waits. Temporal is that foundation, and building AI-native experiences on top of it is paramount to where we are headed. We're looking for a technical, AI-native Staff Product Designer to shape how developers build, run, and scale agents on Temporal, from the agent platform and harness down to the compute and workers that execute them.

You'll design with AI and for AI. You use AI as a core part of how you work, and you bring that fluency to the products developers use to run AI in production. You're comfortable going deep on how workers execute tasks, how compute scales, and what it costs, and you turn that depth into experiences that feel simple. This role owns a focused domain while spanning the full developer experience, well beyond our UI.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design the experiences developers use to build, run, deploy, and observe agentic workloads on Temporal, across Agent Platform, Agent Harness, and Serverless Workers.

- Shape the compute experience end to end, from configuring and scaling workers to understanding usage and cost.

- Create future state prototypes with your design leadership that show where Temporal's agent and compute experiences are headed, giving Product and Engineering a concrete vision to align roadmaps around.

- Work across the surfaces where developers meet Temporal, including the Cloud UI, CLI, SDKs, and documentation.

- Design with AI as a daily practice, using it to explore, prototype, and test ideas faster, and bring that perspective into product decisions.

- Partner with PMs and Engineers from discovery through delivery to define problems, validate direction, and ship at Temporal's pace and scale.

- Contribute to and extend Temporal's Design System for agentic use cases, keeping our expanding product surface consistent.

- Bring rigor to ambiguous, technical problem spaces, translating infrastructure complexity into interfaces that feel simple and clear.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 8+ years of Product Design experience, including senior or staff-level ownership of complex, technical products, with a track record of influencing product direction through strong execution.

- A solid understanding of compute and infrastructure concepts such as workers, scaling, queues, and resource usage, and the ability to discuss them credibly with engineers.

- A portfolio that shows systems thinking and 0→1 work in developer tools, B2B or infrastructure products, dashboards, or similarly dense, data-heavy interfaces.

- Experience designing AI-powered products or agent experiences.

- Fluency with AI tools like Claude or Codex in your own design workflow, along with comfort in GitHub and terminal environments.

- Hands-on experience with Figma.

- Experience partnering directly with Engineering on technically constrained problems, ideally in developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or platform products.

- Experience instrumenting and analyzing product usage to inform design decisions.

- A bias for building. You prototype quickly, often in code or with AI, and you move through build, ship, learn, and iterate cycles in days rather than weeks.

NICE TO HAVE

- Working knowledge of distributed systems, workflow orchestration, or durable execution concepts.

- Experience with serverless platforms, container orchestration, or cloud compute products.

- Familiarity with agentic AI patterns and the challenges of running agents in production.

- Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and comfort reading code.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.

We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.

Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.

We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.

THE ROLE

Airbyte is incubating new product opportunities at the intersection of data, AI, and developer infrastructure. Our small team builds tooling and infrastructure for data practitioners and software engineers, leveraging Airbyte's foundation in enterprise connectivity.

This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We're looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands-on with AI applications or infrastructure. You'll own technical explorations, build prototypes, and take promising ideas through to production.

We're still early. Some of our work extends existing products, while other projects begin as hypotheses that need validation. There's significant room to influence technical direction, challenge assumptions, and help shape what we build next.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Airbyte MCP: Build infrastructure that lets AI agents configure Airbyte, troubleshoot syncs, and access data directly from connected sources and warehouses. Design reliable, secure, and observable interfaces across the connector ecosystem.

- Semantic Search & Retrieval: Build and operate search infrastructure for high-quality retrieval over enterprise data. Improve relevance, latency, and reliability in production.

- Semantic Models: Develop systems for defining and maintaining semantic models over enterprise data. Help AI applications use consistent business definitions and produce answers that can be verified against underlying data.

- SaaS Sandbox: Build realistic, stateful replicas of SaaS systems for developing and testing agents. Reproduce API behavior, failures, and state changes so workflows can be evaluated without using production accounts.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

EXPLORE NEW PRODUCT OPPORTUNITIES

- Turn product hypotheses into focused technical experiments. Build prototypes that test feasibility and expose important constraints.

- Work directly with customers, Product, Design, and customer-facing teams to understand real-world problems and incorporate feedback into technical decisions.

- Evaluate competing technical approaches and use what you learn to influence product direction.

BUILD PRODUCTION-GRADE INFRASTRUCTURE

- Design and implement backend systems, APIs, and infrastructure for AI, data, and developer products.

- Build reliable, observable systems with clear failure handling, debugging, and operational safeguards.

- Take promising prototypes into production and improve them based on usage, incidents, and customer feedback.

LEAD TECHNICAL DIRECTION

- Own architecture and execution across technical design, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

- Lead technical decisions that span teams. Align interfaces and dependencies, and influence architecture beyond your immediate projects.

- Communicate priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly, and follow through on commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has shipped AI-powered products.

- 10+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - Outsourcing
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional talentoso e motivado para integrar nosso time! Se você é uma pessoa proativa, que busca constante evolução e gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, esta oportunidade é para você.
Ayko, juntos para transformar!

•
Monitoramento e Detecção: Acompanhamento contínuo de eventos de segurança (SIEM, EDR, XDR, firewalls) para identificar comportamentos suspeitos e IoCs.

•
Análise e Priorização: Triagem, correlação e classificação de alertas de segurança com foco em criticidade.

•
Operação de SOC: Apoio à rotina do Security Operations Center, colaborando com analistas, infraestrutura e desenvolvimento.

•
Tratamento de Incidentes: Atuação na resposta a incidentes, investigação de causa raiz e cumprimento de SLAs e playbooks.

•
Contenção e Hardening: Apoio nas fases de resposta pós-incidente, aplicação de medidas de melhoria contínua e boas práticas em servidores, redes e nuvem.

•
Documentação e Relatórios: Elaboração de relatórios técnicos, playbooks, runbooks e registro estruturado de incidentes.

•
Governança e Alinhamento: Participação em reuniões técnicas, definição de prioridades, planejamento de melhorias e interface com compliance.

•
Administração de Sistemas: Gerenciamento de segurança de rede (firewalls, antivírus) e suporte à plataforma Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive).

• Graduação em andamento ou concluída em Segurança da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

• Conhecimento inicial sobre princípios de segurança (confidencialidade, integridade, disponibilidade);

• Conhecimento em soluções como SIEM, EDR e NDR;

• Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais (Windows e Linux) e ferramentas de segurança (antivírus, IDS/IPS);

• Noções de análise de vulnerabilidades e gestão de riscos;

• Capacidade de interpretar logs e eventos de sistemas;

• Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais relevantes para redes, como Windows Server, Linux e suas respectivas ferramentas de rede;

• Compreensão dos princípios de segurança de rede, como autenticação, autorização e criptografia;

•
